description: PostgreSQL allows a GENERATED ... AS IDENTITY column that is not the table's PRIMARY KEY; sqlite3 has no way to express auto-increment independent of PRIMARY KEY, so this must be rejected rather than silently dropping the auto-increment behavior or emitting SQL sqlite3 would reject

body: CREATE TABLE tF{{DLID}} (id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, other_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)

tests.name: error message explains the dialect translation failure
